newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended down at an intra-day low of 8.3020 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.3008 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan was pushed down by some banks fifteen minutes before the close, but it was unlikely to fall further during the rest of this week.
The yuan opened slightly up at 8.3005 and rose further to an intra-day high of 8.3001 early in the session. It then fall to consolidate around 8.3010 before moving down to close at its low.
Trading was most active at about 8.3010, traders said.
"There was strong selling just below the key 8.3000 level to cap the yuan," one dealer said.
"Some banks sold the local unit just before the end in order to hurt the pro-yuan sentiment. But the falls will have little impact on the yuan's trend in the short term," he added.
Dealers expect the yuan to move around 8.3010 on Thursday.
The yuan ended up at 7.3331 from 7.3640 against 100 Japanese yen and up at an intra-day high of 1.0725 from 1.0737 against the Hong Kong dollar.
